protocol.timingBoundary: First source-chunk request through final CPU-readable PCM; excludes initialization, validation, hashing, WAV encoding and save. Optional articleCallPeakRssBytes spans the entire browser call including post-timer validation/export.

environment.machineLabel: MacBook Pro / Apple M1 Pro 8-core / 16 GiB / arm64

support.scope: Exact 157,190-parameter Atom v3 core and six fixed voice embeddings; rule-based English frontend with no neural POS model
support.notes: Hope, Sophia, Cassidy, James, Jasper and Mark; benchmark selects Cassidy. Local FP32 ONNX + WASM DSP browser port, with explicitly normalized line whitespace and a specified seeded noise stream. WebGPU accelerates the convolutional decoder; GRU encoder/frontend/DSP remain WASM.

cells.precision: FP32 ONNX acoustic core; FP32 DSP with FP64 long-utterance phase accumulation

settings.frontend: eSpeak NG 1.52.0 + Misaki 0.9.4 espeak-light mapping; CR/LF/TAB converted to spaces before G2P; unknown phones fail
settings.chunking: Canonical spans; upstream 510-phone limit and greedy 200-phone internal splitting when needed, 80 ms internal pauses
settings.noiseGenerator: Pinned C++ MT19937 + polar Box-Muller standard-normal noise; same browser stream on both providers, not PyTorch bitwise RNG parity
settings.runtime: ONNX Runtime Web 1.23.2; Emscripten 3.1.74 DSP and eSpeak; encoder always WASM
settings.executionProviderScope: executionProviders selects the convolution decoder; encoder, frontend and DSP always use WASM

capability.description: One-thread WASM acoustic inference and local WASM DSP/frontend

notes: Capability checks run separately before timing. GPU dispatch does not imply GPU-exclusive execution.
Raw WAV is saved locally; opt-in audio publication is separate from timing and automatic result submission.

Atom v3 English Cassidy, FP32 acoustic encoder/decoder, one WASM thread, exact local espeak-light frontend, seeded MT19937/polar noise7717. WebGPU decoder with WASM encoder/DSP; same settings on CPU. Exclusive M1 benchmark lock; Now drawing from 'AC Power'. Run order: CPU and WebGPU smoke, CPU and WebGPU cached, CPU and WebGPU warm.
